mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.0% signals labor market weakness and impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 7.0), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor market expands (PAYEMS growth) but housing starts contract (HOUST decline), the resulting sectoral imbalance signals economic fragility, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, elevated CPIAUCSL (above 230) signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank hawkishness and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 230) during tightening cycles, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST above 900) indicates robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above 900, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals weakening manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise above 900 while retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 400,000, it indicates a weak consumer sector, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS below 135,000) signals worsening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition (PAYEMS < 135000) during high unemployment regimes, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
